page.layout: One column of running text on the right printed page; running head above the text, page number at its top right. The left edge shows fragments of the facing page, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: huius muneris partem in æ-quitate respondenda posui-mus: cum scilicet, ubi scripta lex nulla est, quid æqui bonique ratio postulet, ambigi-tur: quam quidem longè primam ac præstantissimam esse muneris istius partem, Cicero multis uerbis in libro de Legib. primo demõstrat, ubi iuris scribit in mēte[?] sapientis rationeque esse positum, eamque uerissimam esse iuris atque iniuriæ regulam. ita que constituendi iuris ab illa regula capiendum esse exordium, quæ seculis omnibus ante nota fit, quàm scripta lex ulla, aut quàm omnino consti-

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "postulet" was read as "poftulet" on the scan. "mēte" is uncertain: the macron over the e is hard to see. The line "huius muneris" is an unresolved continuation from the previous page. No marginal notes or catchword are printed on this page.
